rows.label: Status
rows.text: Established under the IIM Act 2017; an Institute of National Importance.

rows.label: Campus
rows.text: About 200 acres on National Highway 10 at Sunaria, Rohtak, in the National Capital Region. The institute puts it 90 minutes from Delhi's international airport.

rows.label: Accredited
rows.text: AMBA. The fifth IIM to gain it, after Calcutta, Indore, Kozhikode and Lucknow, and the first of the second- and third-generation IIMs.

rows.label: Accredited
rows.text: Business Graduates Association (BGA), for its undergraduate business education.

rows.label: Ranked
rows.text: 151+ in the QS World University Rankings 2024 for postgraduate management programmes, in its first entry.

rows.label: Ranked
rows.text: 8th among B-schools in the Outlook-ICARE India MBA Rankings 2021.

rows.label: Programmes
rows.text: PGP, PGPx, five-year IPM (management), five-year IPL (law), doctoral programme (DPM), ePGDSM in sports management, MMS in public policy, and executive education.
